params.initialSupply: Number of whole tokens minted to the caller

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

allTokens(uint256).notice: All tokens ever deployed by this factory

createToken(string,string,uint8,uint256).notice: Deploy a new ERC-20 token.  Caller must send at least `creationFee` ETH.

tokensByCreator(address,uint256).notice: Tokens deployed by a given creator address

withdrawETH().notice: Rescue any ETH accidentally sent directly to this contract

userdoc.notice: Allows anyone to launch a new ERC-20 token by paying a small creation fee.         The fee is forwarded to a configurable `feeReceiver` address.
